title: Signal Storm: Rapid Market Intelligence Accelerator for Model Landscape
creator: Aisha Mehta
description: We need a lightweight, repeatable pipeline that turns raw model ecosystem signals into prioritized, operational watch items for PM/Eng/Sales. This ticket scopes 'Signal Storm' — an accelerator for continuous scouting, triage, and handoff: - Ingest telemetry: public model releases, GitHub activity, quant/weight drops, benchmark leaks, pricing changes, region availability. - Normalize signals into a compact scorecard (Quality Drift, Supply Fragility, Latency Arbitrage, Commercial Shock). - Auto-prioritize into a watchlist and route to responsible squads with contextual evidence and suggested probes. Goal: reduce manual triage time for model-landscape alerts by 80% and increase actionable watch items surfaced per week from ~3 to ~20.
acceptance_criteria: Ingestors: at least 4 automated feeds (GitHub releases, model-repo tags, pricing API, vendor status page) producing normalized events to the Signal Storm topic.
Scorecard: every event must map to a 4-metric score (Quality Drift, Supply Fragility, Latency Risk, Commercial Impact) with documented weighting and a provenance link.
Watchlist: UI (Notion / lightweight dashboard) shows a weekly prioritized watchlist with evidence links and suggested actions for PM/Eng/SE.
Alerting: High-impact events (score >= 8/10) generate Slack notifications to #model-watch and create a prefilled Linear ticket template.
Handoff: For top-5 weekly items, the ticket includes suggested micro-probes (synthetic workload, quantization compatibility test, RAG latency probe) and an assigned owner or "unassigned" tag.
Metrics: Measure triage time baseline and show >=80% reduction in manual triage effort after first month of running.
tasks: Design normalized event schema and minimal provenance fields (schema doc in Drive)
Implement 4 initial ingest connectors (GitHub model-releases, huggingface model metadata, vendor pricing API, cloud region availability feed)
Build scorecard lambda that applies weights and produces a single composite priority score
Create Notion watchlist template and simple dashboard (looker / internal BI) for weekly view
Wire Slack alerting and Linear ticket creation with template payload
Run two pilot weeks and capture triage time / false positive rate metrics
Loop in Solutions/SE for customer-impact validation and get 5 customer corroborations
research_findings: Initial reconnaissance found high signal density in GitHub releases and pricing endpoints; many low-noise events can be filtered by matching major version bump + release notes containing 'quant' or 'int8'.
Vendor status pages are noisy but provide early capacity outage signals when correlated across regions.
Public benchmarks (independent labs) often lag real-world latency regressions; supplement with synthetic small-context microbench probes.
Sales and SE teams want 'impact narrative' bundled with technical notes (one-sentence customer story + suggested mitigation).
priority_rationale: Tightening model landscape and procurement risk make automated scouting high leverage for Dedicated/Private sales and runtime optimization teams.
risks: False positives from noisy public feeds could overload squads
Data provenance gaps could reduce trust in auto-prioritization
Maintenance overhead for connectors if vendor APIs change frequently
mitigations: Start with conservative thresholds and human-in-loop review for first 4 weeks
Include provenance link and raw payload in watchlist items
Build connector health monitors and slack alerts for schema drift
metrics_to_track: Number of actionable watch items surfaced per week
implementation_notes: Prefer small, idempotent lambdas and event-based topics. Keep the first MVP readable in Notion rather than building a heavy console view. Use existing infra for secret management and webhook relay. Coordinate with ENG infra (ENG-7821) to reuse onboarding flow.
